北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风力不小，体感稍凉，注意防风保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is breezy and feels cool, remember to keep warm!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波多云体感热，湿度高，多喝水，小心别中暑哦！
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is cloudy and feels warm with high humidity. Stay hydrated and watch out for heatstroke!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云暖和，湿度较高，穿着舒适就好，出门注意防晒！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and warm with high humidity, dress comfortably and remember sun protection!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州温暖湿度高，注意防潮，多喝水补充水分哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is warm and very humid, remember to stay hydrated and protect from dampness!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳有点热哦，体感近 28℃，多云湿度高，注意补水防暑！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is quite warm, feels near 28℃. Stay hydrated and prevent heatstroke!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感较热，湿度也高，记得多喝水，避免闷热哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast and feels warm with high humidity. Stay hydrated!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天风力不小，体感微凉，记得添衣保暖，别着凉！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast and windy, feels a bit cool. Remember to add layers and keep warm!
南京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：西北风 4级

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度爆表 100%，出门带伞，注意防潮哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast with 100% humidity. Take an umbrella and watch out for dampness!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感有点冷，湿度还高，出门多穿衣，注意保暖！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast and feels cold with high humidity. Dress warmly when going out!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云有点凉，湿度较高，记得添衣，小心着凉感冒哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and a bit cool with high humidity. Remember to add layers to avoid catching a cold!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云舒适，气温 20℃ 左右，适合户外活动，心情棒棒！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and comfortable around 20℃. Perfect for outdoor activities!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨小雨大风，体感 4℃ 很冷，注意防雨保暖，小心路滑！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin has light rain and strong winds, feels very cold at 4℃. Keep warm, stay dry, and watch for slippery roads!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳中雨，湿度 100%，体感稍凉，出门记得带伞，注意保暖！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang has moderate rain and 100% humidity. Feels a bit cool, remember your umbrella and stay warm!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗但有点凉，湿度也高，记得添衣，享受阳光哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny but a bit cool with high humidity. Remember to add layers and enjoy the sun!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门大雾弥漫，能见度低，出门开车注意安全，小心慢行！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is very foggy with low visibility. Drive carefully and slowly!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛风力 7 级，体感很冷，注意防风保暖，大风天出行安全！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has 7-level winds, feels very cold. Keep warm and stay safe in strong winds!
青岛.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 7级

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连风力 6 级，体感较凉，风大人多穿衣，注意防风保暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian has 6-level winds, feels cool. Dress warmly, protect from wind and stay warm!
大连.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 6级

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦有雾，能见度不高，出行注意交通安全，保持车距。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is foggy with low visibility. Pay attention to traffic safety and keep your distance!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪今天暖和又湿润，多喝水，防晒别忘啦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is warm and humid today, stay hydrated and don't forget sun protection!
